title: When the Fire of God Falls: Victorious Faith in the Face of Opposition
description: Join Pastor Chris Zehner as he explores the dramatic story of Elijah's prayer of faith in 1 Kings 18, where the prophet calls down fire from heaven and defeats the prophets of Baal, revealing the true and mighty God of Israel. In this powerful sermon, Pastor Chris will show how Elijah's example of bold and unwavering faith can inspire us to confront the spiritual battles in our own lives and experience the same kind of divine intervention. Get ready to be challenged and equipped to live a life of victory and faith in the midst of spiritual warfare.
